questions: Should the output for each test case be printed on a separate line, or can they be concatenated in any format as long as the order matches?
If multiple pairings yield the same maximum total price, is any of them acceptable, or does the problem require the exact maximum value?
Are the pairs ordered (i.e., does the order of pairs matter for the total price)?
Can a cake be paired with itself (i.e., a_i = b_i)?
Is the pairing required to be a perfect matching (i.e., all cakes used) or can some cakes remain unpaired?
If not all cakes need to be used, can we choose any subset of 2K cakes to pair, or must we use a specific selection?
Does the pairing require that each pair is formed by two distinct cakes (which is already clear), but can a cake appear in multiple pairs?
Should the output be the maximum total price as an integer, or could it be in any format (e.g., scientific notation)?
